personality_one_liner: A high-clarity, industrial, function-first command center that treats safety operations like a physical control panel.

spacing.rule: Use rigid grids, edge-to-edge sections, thick dividers, exposed structure, and visible spacing systems. Strong hierarchy.

dont's: No glassmorphism or blur effects. Use solid colors and harsh dividers per Brutalist rules.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A dashboard showing safety modules, recent activity, and quick stats for the warehouse.

states.loading: High-contrast monochrome skeleton with a rigid grid structure.
states.empty: N/A - Dashboard will always have default stats or access modules.
states.error: Harsh red border with oversized bold error text and a mechanical Retry button.

screens.layout: Use a rigid grid. Top header with warehouse title. Below, 2-column or full-width bold metric cards (open incidents, active locks) with thick borders. Below that, edge-to-edge list of quick actions (AI Assess, LOTO, Access). Oversized counters.

screens.name: AIAssess
screens.purpose: Camera-based AI assessment for Risk, SWMS, Worker Density, and Machinery Safety.

states.loading: Camera view covered with an overlay of scanning lines and mono-spaced 'ANALYSING...' text.
states.empty: Camera viewfinder with harsh corner brackets. Instructions to 'Capture hazard or machinery'.
states.error: Error modal with sharp corners, stating 'AI Analysis Failed. Retake Photo.' in strong typography.

screens.layout: Camera viewfinder fills top 60%. Bottom 40% is a structured panel (or bottom sheet without drag handles, just a rigid panel) containing segmented controls to select mode (Risk, SWMS, Density, Machinery). After capture, the panel expands with risk matrix ratings (color-coded blocks), hazards found, and an export to PDF action.

screens.name: Registers
screens.purpose: List of Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) locks, their statuses, and controls to add/remove.

states.loading: List of structural divider lines with grey blocks.
states.empty: Brutalist empty state: 'NO ACTIVE LOTO LOCKS' in oversized text, with a large primary action 'REGISTER LOCK'.
states.error: Text block with an error message and a reload action.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge list items separated by thick 2pt borders. Each row features a hard-edged status badge (e.g., Safe Green or Warning Amber), machine ID, and an action button.

screens.name: Access
screens.purpose: Digital Site Access Control for sign in/out, contractor induction, and QR records.

states.loading: Centered spinning square or thick loader.
states.empty: Large QR code placeholder with instruction to scan.
states.error: Sharp error container with 'Access Denied or Failed to Load' text.

screens.layout: Large, high-contrast QR code centered for scanning. Stacked mechanical buttons for 'Sign In', 'Sign Out', and 'Visitor Induction'. Strong structural dividers separating the access records history.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User details, app settings, and document export history.
screens.layout: Simple, functional list layout with 2pt borders separating settings items. Monospaced labels for export history timestamps.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a Brutalist Mobile LIGHT aesthetic: sharp corners (radius 0), thick structural borders (borderStrong), and no shadows or glassmorphism.
Rely heavily on Space Grotesk for large, punchy headers and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Use mono-spaced fonts for metrics, numbers, and timestamps to emphasize the industrial vibe.
For the AI Assess screen, build a mechanical, scanner-like interface. When 'Analysing', overlay the camera feed with a high-contrast mono-spaced text and scanning brackets.
Ensure all safety signal colors (red, amber, green) are used functionally, not decoratively. Apply them as solid background blocks with white text for maximum visibility in a warehouse environment.
Implement bottom tab navigation using Phosphor icons. Tab items should have a sharp, active state (e.g., solid 2pt top border when active).
Follow the 'No dead-ends' UX principle from research: every screen must have an obvious next mechanical step (e.g., 'Retake', 'Export PDF', 'Register Lock').
Include subtle haptic feedback for major actions (like capturing a photo, completing an analysis, or registering a LOTO lock).
